title: Project configuration, editing and diagnostic contract (protocol 14)
description: Protocol-13 configuration, editing and diagnostic structures. Transport requires strict Unicode and signed-64-bit decimal integer tokens. x-maxUtf8Bytes asserts a UTF-8 byte constraint; x-npmRange asserts bounded nonempty npm SemVer range syntax. Linked normative contracts define references, state and filesystem checks.

Version.description: npm SemVer range. Partial versions select a release family; three-component versions are exact. Empty requirements are invalid; omit version for presence-only inspection.
